explanation: OEIS A227582 (g.f. (2 + 3x + 2x² + 2x³ + 3x⁴ + x⁵ − x⁶)/(1 − 2x + x² − x⁵ + 2x⁶ − x⁷), offset 1): the conjecture from A227581 is a(n) = floor(1/(2H(n) − H(n² + n − 1) − γ)). The formal a is built from the recurrence with the first seven DATA terms 2, 7, 14, 23, 35, 50, 67 as initial values (1-indexed), and the statement is the floor identity for n > 0. Faithful.
